name: EPIC 211003469
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 11.7 solar radii and 1.54 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211003469 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.652887 (16th-84th percentiles 11.14324-12.202623), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,934 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.54 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,791 K at its surface.
